text:
emi: Flagging Mantle v1 multilingual bring-up  small but consistent locale regressions. zh/ko token boundary glue and he/ar bracket mirroring. BLEU down ~9% on our locale slice.
carlos: can you paste minimal repros?
emi: sure, two tiny ones below.

emi: ```
input (zh): 我们去公园。
gold (en): We went to the park.
pred (en): We went to the park the kids had fun
```

emi: ```
input (he): שלום (המשפט)
gold (en): Hello (the sentence)
pred (en): Hello )the sentence(
```

yuri: That zh example looks like ideographic punctuation got eaten or attached to previous token. training tokenizer had no unicode normalization. runtime picked up NFKC + collapse-zwj.
leila: if normalization differs we'll get prefix cache misaligns. did you check kv-cache traces?
emi: yeskv profiler shows prefix length mismatches of 1-2 tokens on many failures. sample set uploaded: s3://rwd-evals/mantle/v1/3223344556/token-diffs/ (includes train vs runtime token lists).
ci-bot: eval-runner-3223: mantle-v1 sweep (n=1800) completed  164 flagged (regression thresh 5%).
carlos: seen only on quant?
yuri: both fp16 and q4/q5 show it, q-kernels amplify merges. bracket mirroring for he/ar appears when RLM/LRM get stripped by normalizer.
leila: plan: 1) run a 300-sample canary with runtime normalizer set to training parity (disable NFKC and collapse ZWJ), 2) add bidi-preservation unit test for brackets/quotes (he/ar), 3) run fp16 vs q5 canary with kvtrace.
emi: I'll start the canary and pin the vocab used in training to rule out vocab drift.
carlos: +1 on vocab pin. also add per-locale BLEU alerts (zh/ko/he/ar) with a 2% auto-triage threshold.
yuri: i'll instrument tokenization diffs to surface top offending token merges and emit small examples in the canary report.
emi: thanks team. tagging @yuri @leila. will post canary link when done. :thumbsup:
